mapper.sql: ft.id, ft.title, ft.task_type, ft.related_object_type, ft.related_object_id, case ft.related_object_type when 'CLUE' then (select full_name from t_clue where id = ft.related_object_id) when 'CUSTOMER' then (select customer_name from t_customer where id = ft.related_object_id) when 'OPPORTUNITY' then (select opportunity_no from t_opportunity where id = ft.related_object_id) when 'TEST_DRIVE' then (select test_drive_no from t_test_drive where id = ft.related_object_id) when 'ORDER' then (select tran_no from t_tran where id = ft.related_object_id) else null end as related_object_name, ft.owner_id, u.name AS owner_name, ft.priority, ft.due_time, ft.remind_time, ft.status, ft.result, ft.postpone_reason, ft.original_due_time, ft.postpone_count, ft.cancel_reason, ft.communication_record_id, ft.completed_time, ft.completed_by, ft.version, ft.create_time, ft.create_by, ft.update_time, ft.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_follow_task ft LEFT JOIN t_user u ON ft.owner_id = u.id WHERE ft.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_follow_task ft LEFT JOIN t_user u ON ft.owner_id = u.id WHERE ft.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_follow_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_follow_task SET status = 'POSTPONED', due_time = #{newDueTime}, remind_time = #{remindTime}, postpone_reason = #{postponeReason}, original_due_time = #{originalDueTime}, postpone_count = postpone_count + 1, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_follow_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_follow_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', result = #{result}, communication_record_id = #{communicationRecordId}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, completed_by = #{completedBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
